domain: A small Node.js module that totals a shopping basket, prices in pence. Plain JavaScript with no dependencies, tested with node:test. plan.md is the list of tests still to write.

steps.name: red
steps.prompt: Write exactly one new test for the behaviour this task describes, and nothing else: no code yet. Run npm test and check it fails for the reason you expect. Tick the test off in plan.md only in the refactor step, not now.

steps.name: green
steps.prompt: One test is failing. Make it pass with the simplest code that could work, and change no test. Run npm test until every test passes.

steps.name: refactor
steps.prompt: Every test passes. Tidy the code you just wrote without changing what it does: remove duplication, name things clearly. Then tick the test off in plan.md. Do not change any test.
